evidence.claim: Telegram Bot Platform prohibits spam, harassment, data scraping, social growth manipulation, and rate-limit circumvention
evidence.value: TPAs must not harass/spam users, must not attempt to circumvent rate limits, must not operate by proxy, social growth manipulation is explicitly forbidden, data scraping for ML/AI products is prohibited

evidence.claim: NN/g recommends glassmorphism with WCAG contrast requirements and more blur for complex backgrounds
evidence.value: Ensure WCAG contrast, use more blur for complex backgrounds, allow users to adjust transparency

evidence.claim: Command palette (⌘K) is a 2026 SaaS retention driver, used by Linear, Notion, GitHub, Vercel
evidence.value: Most retention-focused SaaS products let users find anything in under 2 seconds via CMD+K

variants: Telegram native blue #2AABEE vs TelegramGeeks accent #0088CC
conflicts.resolution: Different saturation levels, different usage contexts. Telegram blue reserved for platform elements; TelegramGeeks accent for brand elements.

variants: NN/g warns of WCAG challenges with translucent backgrounds vs. Apple/Microsoft adoption
conflicts.resolution: Restricted to non-text UI elements only; solid fallbacks for prefers-reduced-transparency users.
